name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois discovered her passion for motorsport through her father, a rally enthusiast. She pursued electrical engineering, graduating at the top of her class. Sophie's career began in aerospace, but the allure of racing proved too strong. She transitioned to motorsport, initially working on data acquisition systems before specializing in vehicle electronics. Sophie joined Manthey EMA two years ago, where her meticulous approach and diagnostic skills quickly made her an invaluable asset.

Her approach to electronics engineering is deeply rooted in understanding the entire system. Sophie doesn't just troubleshoot; she seeks to optimize performance and reliability by understanding the interplay between components. She’s known for her ability to quickly diagnose complex electrical faults, often under immense pressure, a trait crucial in the fast-paced world of motorsport.

What sets Sophie apart is her proactive attitude. She constantly seeks innovative solutions to improve vehicle performance and reliability. She's currently leading a project to enhance the data logging capabilities of the team's GT3 cars, which could give Manthey EMA a significant competitive advantage.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back into a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Sophie is of average height with a focused expression and a strong build.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool on her belt.
Has a collection of vintage circuit board components on her desk.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee, especially during race weekends.
